overlays.label: ESO VISTA · near infrared
overlays.registrationNote: Matched-star relative registration to the native SMASH TIFF. Publisher sky anchor retained; simulation correspondence and unobserved depths are not measured. Publisher 4000px derivative; full 43223×38236 PSB not acquired (4.4GB).

overlays.label: NOIRLab SMASH · optical
overlays.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever (Montana State University); image processing Travis Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage), Mahdi Zamani and Davide de Martin
overlays.registrationNote: Matched-star relative registration to the native SMASH TIFF. Publisher sky anchor retained; simulation correspondence and unobserved depths are not measured. Existing source-originals TIFF reused; downloaded JPEG is alternate representation, not an independent observation.

overlays.label: DSS2 · optical
overlays.credit: ESA/Hubble and Digitized Sky Survey 2; acknowledgement Davide De Martin (ESA/Hubble)
overlays.registrationNote: Matched-star relative registration to the native SMASH TIFF. Publisher sky anchor retained; simulation correspondence and unobserved depths are not measured. Full-resolution publisher JPEG; 421.7MB TIFF deferred. Smaller footprint than VISTA/SMASH; not outer tidal-tail coverage.

overlays.label: NASA WISE · infrared · alignment pending
overlays.registrationNote: Relative stellar fit through VISTA shown for inspection. Negative wrong-scale control did not pass the fixed threshold; reconstruction remains blocked. Original publisher projection is SIN; it has not been relabeled TAN. Native publisher TIFF. Two satellite streaks in upper half; central cloud field, not full tidal tail. SIN projection must remain explicit.

overlays.label: AllWISE · 10° infrared
overlays.registrationNote: Fixed publisher TAN WCS independently checked against 7,172 bright AllWISE catalogue W1 stars, with unchanged control thresholds and no fitted transform. Survey coordinates and image share mission data; diffuse emission and depth are not validated.

overlays.label: Herschel + Spitzer · far infrared · metadata placement
overlays.registrationNote: Inspection candidate only; not approved for reconstruction. Whole bar and wing; dust-temperature colour composite. Same observation as Spitzer ssc2012-01b, excluded duplicate. Nonstellar compact dust structures must be preserved.

overlays.label: Spitzer · far infrared · approximate placement
overlays.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/K. Gordon (STScI); caption also credits NASA/JPL-Caltech/STScI
overlays.registrationNote: Approximate initial placement from publisher webpage centre, extent and orientation. Corrected rotation sign: North 148.4° left of vertical corresponds to AVM rotation +148.4° in the shared WCS implementation. It is NOT a passed registration or verified projection; do not process. Publisher caption/table inconsistent: narrative specifically describes MIPS 24/70/160 composite. No embedded AVM found; webpage approximate astrometry alone not qualified. Full bar/wing/tail field.

overlays.label: Herschel / Planck / IRAS · gas and dust
overlays.registrationNote: Inspection only; reconstruction disabled until qualified. Whole cloud gas/dust composite; red hydrogen green cold dust blue warm dust. Preserve nonstellar signal.
